searchText: I defer to Shane. Too busy. planning to work more on the apis when I am back fwiw, I am fine with the custom byte mapping, I had this implemented in lodestar more than ~2 years ago and tested already, it's also backward compatbile and doesn't require an api bump which is nice will reread and give any more thoughts later today, already implemented as is for the most part there might be a place or two i've missed something so i want to double check I think we can define these configurations in the builder-specs. And standardize the different builder related flags like the below in the builder-specs: 1. min bid 2. bid boost for p2p and builder-api. The most important flag based on my convo with lido seems to be min-bid. I can update this PR with the flags and client-devs can pitch in: https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/144 I definitely need to implement the broadcast_validation option for payload envelopes, catching up on that.
